name: Tokiwa
source:
A blond haired boy of a foreign bloodline. Just until the other day, he was one of the top requested, but when a female customer attempted to kidnap him, he made a scene. As a punishment, he was moved to Takao's attendant to retrain his skills. 

From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/381100/The_Men_of_Yoshiwara_Kikuya/]Steam[/url]
